<entry id="N00115">
<head-word>נָגַב</head-word>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (cmp. גַּב) [
<italic>to have a crust,</italic>] 
<italic>to be dry</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ab. Zar. V, 3 (69
<sup>a</sup>) כדי שישתום … ויִגּוֹב as much time as would be required for a person to bore a hole (uncork), and close it up, and (for the sealing clay) to get dry; ib. כדי שיפתח (את החבית) … ותִיגּוֹב to open the jug and close it up again, and (for the clay) to dry; a. e.—Part. pass. נָגוּב; f. נְגוּבָה; pl. נְגוּבִים, נְגוּבִין; נְגוּבוֹת 
<italic>dry</italic>. Ḥag. III, 3 אוכלים נ' dry eatables (which have not come in contact with liquids and are, therefore, insusceptible of levitical uncleanness, v. הֶכְשֵׁר); Tosef. ib. III, 11. Ib. 12 וכי יש נגובים לקדש are the exemptions in favor of dry objects applicable to sacred matter?; Ḥag. 24
<sup>b</sup> וכי יש נגובה וכ' (Ms. M. נְגִיבָה). Ib.
<sup>a</sup>, sq. יד נ' מטמאה וכ' one dry hand (which has become unclean) makes the other hand unclean; a. e.</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pi.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>נִיגֵּב</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to dry, wipe, scour</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ib. III, 1 (20
<sup>b</sup>) מתיר ומְנַגֵּב ומטביל (Bab. ed. ומַנְגִּיב, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 3; Y. ed. מתיר ומטביל) he must open (the knots of the garment) and wipe it dry and smooth and then immerse. Lev. R. s. 28, beg. עד שלא יְנַגְּבָהּ before he gets it (the garment) dry and glossy; ib. ומְנַגֵּב את הארץ and makes the earth dry; Koh. R. to I, 3 ומכבסן ומבשלן ומְנַגְּבָן and washes them (the plants) and ripens and glosses them. Ab. Zar. V, 11 מְנַגְּבָהּ he scours it; ib. 74
<sup>b</sup> במה מְנַגְּבָן וכ' wherewith does he scour them? … with ashes, … with water. Ib. 75
<sup>a</sup>; a. fr.—
<italic>Part. pass</italic>. מְנוּגָּב 
<italic>dry, parched, sapless, bare of</italic>. Tem. 16
<sup>a</sup> (play on הנגב Josh. XV, 19) בית שמנ' מכל וכ' a household bare of all that is good; Yalk. Josh. 27 אדם המנ' וכ' a man bare &c.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הִנְגִּיב</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition> same, v. supra.—2) (denom. of </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<definition>נֶגֶב) 
<italic>to go south</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Erub. 53
<sup>b</sup> (in an enigmatic speech) וה' למפיבשת and went south to the great scholar (v. מְפִיבשֶׁת).</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Nithpa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>נִתְנַגֵּב</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to be dried up</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Sifra B’ḥuck. ch. I ונִתְנַגְּבָה הארץ the ground was dried up; Lev. R. s. 35.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="N00116">
<head-word>נְגֵב</head-word>
<head-word>נְגוּב</head-word>
<head-word>נְגֵיב</head-word>

<language-reference>same</language-reference>

<definition>, 
<italic>to be dry, to dry out</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Gen. VIII, 13; a. e.—Y. Sabb. V, beg. 7
<sup>b</sup> כדו נגיב אינון וכ' when it is dry, they name it Egyptian bean; Y. Kil. VIII, 31
<sup>c</sup>.—Y. Gitt. VII, end, 49
<sup>a</sup> ונ' נהרא the canal dried up. Ib. דיִיגַּב וכ' that the canal may dry up; a. e.</notes></sense></senses>

<binyan-name>Pa.</binyan-name>

<notes> B. Mets. 24
<sup>a</sup> ונ' בגלימא וכ' wiped (his hands) on his neighbor’s cloak; a. e.—
<italic>Part. pass</italic>. מְנַגַּב; f. מְנַגְּבָא 
<italic>parched</italic>. Targ. Y. Num. XI, 6.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Ithpe.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>אִתְנְגִיב, </binyan-form>

<italic>to be dried up</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Y. Gen. I, 9. Targ. Ps. CVI, 9; a. e.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="N00117">
<head-word>נָגַד</head-word>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (b. h.) 
<italic>to draw</italic> a line; denom. נֶגֶד.</definition>
<notes /></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הִגִּיד</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (denom. of נֶגֶד) 
<italic>to show; to announce, tell; to testify</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Tanḥ. Tsav 13 ומשם … והִגִּידָה לאהרן from there Miriam learned it and told Aaron. Ib. מַגִּיד שהכל מודים וכ' this shows (intimates) that all agreed as to her beauty. Snh. IV, 5 להַגִּיד גדולתו וכ' to show the greatness &c. Ib. 44
<sup>b</sup>, a. e. (ref. to Lev. V, </notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition />
<notes> כיון שה' שוב אינו חוזר ומַגִּיד after he has once testified, he cannot again testify, i.e. is not permitted to retract; a. v. fr.—[Pes. 87
<sup>a</sup>, v. אָגַד.]—V. מַגִּיד.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hof.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הוּגַּד</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to be told, proclaimed</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Yalk. Koh. 989 שה' לה בסיני the word which has been proclaimed at Sinai; a. e.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pi.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>נִגֵּד</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to oppose</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Yeb. 63
<sup>a</sup>; Yalk. Gen. 23 (ref. to כנגדו, Gen. II, 18) זכה כנגדו לא זכה מְנַגַּדְתּוֹ if he is favored, she will be corresponding to (in harmony with) him, if not, she will oppose him (Rashi: ‘she will be a lash to him’, v. נִגְדָּא II); Pirke’ d’R. El. ch. XII א"ת כנגדו אלא לנגדו אם זכה תהיה לו עזר ואם לאו לנַגְּדוֹ להלחם read not 
<italic>k’negdo</italic>, but 
<italic>l’nagg’do</italic>; if he is favored, she will be a help to him, if not, ‘to oppose him’, to fight.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="N00118">
<head-word>נְגַד</head-word>
<head-word>נְגִיד</head-word>
<language-key> ch. </language-key>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition> (corresp. to h. מָשַׁךְ, נָטָה a. אָרַךְ) 
<italic>to stretch; to draw, pull, spread</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Jud. XVI, 30. Targ. Deut. XXI, 3. Targ. Jer. XLIII, 10.—Targ. Ps. LV, 4 יִיגְּדוּן ed. Lag. (ed. Wil. יגרון; h. text ימיטו). Targ. Y. Deut. XVII, 20. Targ. Y. Ex. XII, 21 נגודו ידיכון וכ' withdraw your hands from (v. מָשַׁךְ); a. fr.—Succ. 4
<sup>b</sup> גּוּד אסיק וכ' stretch and raise the partitions, i.e. adopt the legal fiction that the partitions around the stand are prolonged so as to reach the ceiling (v. דּוֹפָן). Sabb. 101
<sup>a</sup> גוּד אחית וכ' stretch and bring the partitions down, i.e. adopt the fiction that the walls are prolonged so as to reach the bottom. Erub. 4
<sup>b</sup> לְגוּד, v. לָבוּד. Gitt. 68
<sup>b</sup> נְגִידוּ מיניה מיכליה (Rashi: נְגוּדוּ) withdraw his food from him, reduce his rations. B. Mets. 74
<sup>a</sup> למידש ולמִנְגַּד to tread the grapes and to conduct the wine into the pit. Ib. 84
<sup>b</sup> נַגְדוּ מתותיה וכ' they drew from under him sixty &c., v. מְשִׂיכְלָא. B. Bath. 111
<sup>b</sup> גוד לית וכ' draw (take me away from here), this man does not want to learn. Pesik. B’shall., p. 90
<sup>a</sup>; Koh. R. to X, 8 גוד חמי לי lead the way, show it to me. Bekh. 44
<sup>b</sup> נגדו ליה גלימא they spread for him (held up between him and the people) a cloak. Erub. 94
<sup>a</sup> שקולו … נְגִידוּ בה take a cloak and spread it (as a partition); a. v. fr.—Ab. I, 13 נְגַד שמא וכ' he who stretches his fame (is ambitious), will lose his name.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to lash</italic>, v. 
<italic>Pa</italic>.</definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to guide, rule</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Ruth I, 1 (h. text שפט).</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—4)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to grow long; to be drawn, follow after; to flow</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Job XXI, 33 (h. text ימשוך). Targ. Jer. VI, 4 (h. tex ינטו). Targ. Cant. I, 4 נְגִדְנָא וכ' we 
<pgbrk id="pg872" />are drawn after &c. Targ. Deut. XXXIII, 13; 22; a. fr. (v. נְגַר).—B. Bath. 91
<sup>b</sup> והוה נָגֵיד חוטא וכ' a line of honey flowed over both his arms; Y. Peah VII, 20
<sup>a</sup> bot. ונ' מלא וכ' and honey flowed as much as my hands could hold; a. e.—Part. pass. נְגִיד 
<italic>stretched, fainting</italic> (v. 
<italic>Ithpe.</italic>). Targ. Ps. LXXXVIII, 16.—Sabb. 152
<sup>a</sup>, v. 
<italic>Ithpe.</italic></notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>נַגֵּד</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (denom. of נִגְדָּא II) 
<italic>to lash, punish</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Cant. VII, 5 למִינְגַּד … לנַגָּדָא.—Keth. 33
<sup>b</sup> נַגְּדוּהָ, v. אִלְמָלֵא. Kidd. 12
<sup>b</sup> נַגְּדֵיה כרב punish him in accordance with Rab’s practice. Pes. 52
<sup>a</sup> ולִינַגְּדֵיה מר נַגּוּדֵי Ms. (ed. נגידי, corr. acc.) why do you not order him to be lashed?; a. e.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Af.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>אַנְגִּיד</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to declare liable to lashes</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Kidd. l. c.; Yeb. 52
<sup>a</sup>, a. e. רב מַנְגִּיד (על) וכ' Rab decreed punishment for him who &c. Kidd. l. c. לא מינגיד רב (read: מנגיד, as) Yeb. l. c.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Ithpe.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>אִתְנְגִיד, אִתְנְגַד, </binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>, אִינְּגִיד, 
<italic>Ithpa.</italic> אִתְנַגַּד </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be drawn, to extend; to run</italic>.</definition>
<notes>. Targ. Is. XXXIV, 11. Targ. Y. Num. XXV, 8. Targ. Y. Gen. XLV, 19. Targ. Is. XLIV, 3; a. e.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to spread, invade</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. I Sam. XXVII, 10 (h. text פשט); a. e.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be withdrawn</italic>.</definition>
<notes>. Targ. Josh. IV, 18; a. e.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—4)</number>
<definition> [
<italic>to stretch one’s self,</italic>] 
<italic>to faint, fall away, die</italic> (h. גָּוַע).</definition>
<notes> Targ. Gen. XXV, 8; a. fr.—Pes. 50
<sup>a</sup> חלש וא' כי וכ' was sick and fainted (seemed to be dead), and when he came to &c.; B. Bath. 10
<sup>b</sup>. Snh. 39
<sup>a</sup> א' ואתנח he became faint and sighed; Sabb. 152
<sup>a</sup> נגיד ואתנח.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—5)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be lashed</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Macc. 11
<sup>a</sup>; Pes. 113
<sup>b</sup> מִינְּגִיד, v. זִיגּוֹד.—[Kidd. 12
<sup>b</sup> מינגיד, v. supra.]</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="N00119">
<head-word>נֶגֶד</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<language-reference>
<xref rid="A00083"> נָגַד)</xref></language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>line, direction</italic>; prep. נֶ', mostly כְּנֶ' 
<italic>towards, opposite, corresponding to</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Sifra Tsav, Milluim, Par. 1 והלא כבר זיוג … זה נ' זה has not the Scripture, before this, paired the two rams, one to correspond with the other? Tam. II, 5 (29
<sup>a</sup>) כנ' מערבית דרומית משוך וכ' (Mish. ed. מִכְּנֶ') in a line with the south-west corner of the altar continued northward to a distance of &c.; Zeb. 58
<sup>a</sup>. Ib. אם שחטן כְּנֶגְדָּן בקרקע if he slaughtered them in the corresponding direction, but in the ground. Mekh. Yithro, Baḥod, s. 11 (ref. to Ex. XX, 24) כְּנֶגְדּוֹ ‘
<italic>alav</italic> means in a certain direction opposite the altar (not on top of it). Ber. 10
<sup>a</sup> הנהו … כנ' מי אמרן with reference to whom did David compose these five psalms beginning with 
<italic>bar’khi nafshi?</italic> Ib. 26
<sup>b</sup> כנ' תמידין corresponding to the daily offerings. Num. R. s. 18 המחלוקת הזו אינה כְּנֶגְדֵּנוּ אלא כנ' וכ' this rebellion is not directed against us but against &c.; a. v. fr.—Yeb. 63
<sup>a</sup> (ref. to Gen. II, 18) זכה … לא זכה כנגדו if he is favored, she will be his help, if not, she will be against him; ib. כתיב כנַגְּדוֹ וקרינן כְּנֶיגְדּוֹ (missing in Yalk. Gen. 23) following the writing we may read 
<italic>k’nagg’do</italic> (opposing him, v. נָגַד), but the Massoretic reading is 
<italic>k’negdo</italic> (corresponding to him); Gen. R. s. 17 זכה עזר ואם לאו כנגדו; Pirke d’R. El. ch. XII, v. נָגַד.—מִנֶּ' 
<italic>at a distance</italic>. Num. R. s. 2 (ref. to Num. II, 2) מהו מנ' what distance is meant by 
<italic>minneged?</italic>. Ib. ילפינן מנ' מנ' וכ' we draw an analogy between 
<italic>minneged</italic> (Num. l. c.) and 
<italic>minneged</italic> (Gen. XXI, 16) &c.; Gen. R. s. 53 הא למדנו נגד מנגד.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="N00120">
<head-word>נָגְדָּא</head-word>
<head-word>נַגְ'</head-word>
<head-word>נוּגְ'</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (נְגַד) </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>prolongation, length, distance</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Ps. XXI, 5 (ed. Lag. נִיגְ' h. text ארך). Targ. Prov. III, 16 (ed. Lag. נוּגְרָא q. v.); a. fr.—Gen. R. s. 11 לנ' את נגיד לי thou leadest me to a distant place; i.e. thy evidence is far off.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition> [
<italic>lead,</italic>] 
<italic>path, pass.</italic></definition>
<notes>
<italic>—</italic>
<plural-form>Pl. נָגְדִּין, נַגְ'</plural-form>. Targ. Is. XLI, 18; a. e.—Targ. Y. Ex. XIV, 3 נַגְדּוֹי וכ' his narrows in the desert.—נ' דְּמַיִין (or sub. דמיין) 
<italic>river-courses</italic> (corresp. to b. h. יבלי מים). Targ. Is. XLIV, 4. Ib. LIII, 2. Targ. Jer. IV, 11 (h. text שפים). Ib. XVII, 8 נִיגְדִּין ed. Lag. (ed. Wil. נַגְרִין; h. text יוּבַל). Targ. Ez. XXXI, 3 (ed. Lag. נִיגְ'; h. text עֲבֹתִים).</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="N00121">
<head-word>נִגְדָּא</head-word>
<head-word>נִי'</head-word>
<hw-number>I</hw-number>
<pos> m.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition> (נְגַד; = b. h. מֶשֶׁךְ) 
<italic>load, freight</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Ps. CXXVI, 6 (Ms. נוּ', ed. Lag. נִי'). Targ. Job XXVIII, 18.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="N00122">
<head-word>נִגְדָּא</head-word>
<head-word>נִי'</head-word>
<hw-number>II</hw-number>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (נְגַד; cmp. מִשְׁכָא) 
<italic>leather-strap, lash</italic>; trnsf. 
<italic>lashing, punishment</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Yoma 23
<sup>a</sup> פקיע נ' (Ms. M. מַדְרָא) 
<italic>p’</italic>
<italic>ḳ</italic>
<italic>i‘a</italic> (Shek. V, </notes></sense>

<entry id="N00239">
<head-word>נָדַר</head-word>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<language-reference>
<xref rid="A00083"> cmp. נָדָה)</xref></language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> [
<italic>to keep off</italic>,] 
<italic>to vow</italic> (abstinence).</definition>
<notes> Ned. V, 1 שנָדְרוּ זה מזה who vowed not to receive benefits from one another. Ib. III, 6 הנוֹדֵר מיורדי הים he who vows to forbid himself benefits from seafarers. Ib. VI, 1 הנודר מן המבושל who vows to abstain from whatever is cooked. Ib. 77
<sup>b</sup> כל הנודר אע"פ וכ' whoever vows, even if he fulfills his vow, is called a sinner. Ib. I, 1 נ' בנזיר … ובקרבן his is a valid vow implying nazariteship and sacrifice. Naz. IV, 4 שנָדְרָה בנזיר who vowed to be a Nazarite; a. fr.—Imperative: דּוֹר. Snh. III, 2 דּוֹר לי בחיי ראשך vow (swear) to me by anything concerning thy person (and I will accept it as a legal oath). Kidd. 41
<sup>a</sup> דור הנאה ממנו renounce all benefit from him.—Ned. III, 4 נוֹדְרִין להרגין וכ' (Tosef. ib. II, 2 תולין) you are not bound by a vow made to escape robbery by highway-men &c. Arakh. I, 1, a. e. נודרים may vow to dedicate the value of a certain person to the sanctuary, contrad. to עָרַךְ q. v.—
<italic>Part. pass</italic>. נָדוּר 
<italic>being under the obligation of a vow; being the legitimate subject of a vow</italic>. Shebu. 20
<sup>a</sup> והוא שנ' ובא מאותו היום provided he was bound by a vow to fast on that day; Ned. 12
<sup>a</sup> והוא שנ' באותו היום (v. Rashi a. l.). Ib. שנ' ובא מאותו היום ואילך that he has vowed to fast regularly on that day (every week). Ib. 13
<sup>a</sup> דבר הנ' a thing which can be made forbidden by a vow (not otherwise forbidden by law). Ib. 46
<sup>a</sup> תני ונ' הנאה וכ' interpret מודר as meaning, and he through his own vow is forbidden any benefit &c. Naz. 9
<sup>b</sup> נ' ונזיר he is under the influence of a vow (of abstention from dried figs) and is also a Nazarite; a. e.</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Nif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>נִידַּר</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be made the subject of a vow; to have one’s personal value dedicated to the sanctuary</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Arakh. I, 1 נודרים ונִידָּרִים are entitled to dedicate (v. supra) and to be dedicated. Ib. 3 לא נ' cannot be dedicated (has no value); a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be vowed for a sacrifice</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Meg. I, 10 כל שהוא נִידָּר, v. נָדַב; a. e.
<pgbrk id="pg880" /></notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הִדִּיר</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to put a person under the influence of a vow; to prohibit, forbid</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Keth. VII, 1 המַדִּיר את אשתו מליהנות לו if one vows that his wife shall derive no benefit from him. Ib. המדיר … שלא תטעום וכ' if a man (by confirming her vow) subjects his wife to a restriction from tasting &c. Y. ib. 31
<sup>b</sup> ויש אדם שמדיר את אשתו מחיים (not חבירו) can a man forbid his wife that which belongs to the necessaries of life? Ib. bot. הִדִּירָהּ שלא להשאיל וכ' if he, by means of a vow, forbade her to lend to her neighbors a winnow or a sieve. Ned. III, 3 הִדִּירוֹ חבירו וכ' if his friend urged him under a vow to dine with him. Naz. IV, 6 מַדִּיר את בנו בנזיר has power to make his (minor) son a Nazarite; a. fr.—Trnsf. 
<italic>to make inaccessible</italic>. B. Bath. 22
<sup>a</sup> במַדִּיר את כותלו, v. מָדַר.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hof.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הוּדָּר</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to be forbidden by a vow; to be subjected to the influence of a vow</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Gitt. 35
<sup>b</sup> נדר שה' ברבים a votary prohibition imposed on a person in public; ib. 36
<sup>a</sup>; a. e. Ned. IV, 1 המוּדָּר הנאה מחבירו he who is forbidden, by his neighbor’s vow, to derive any benefit &c. Ib. 46
<sup>a</sup> היה אחד מהם מודר וכ' if one was forbidden &c., expl. ‘forbidden through his own vow’, v. supra. Ib. V, 4 המודר אסור he against whom the vow was directed is forbidden (all benefits). Ib. I, 1 מוּדְּרַנִי ממך I will be (as if) subjected to a vow of thine forbidding me any benefit at thy hands. Ib. 5
<sup>a</sup> מודר אני ממך לא משתעינא וכ' ‘I will be 
<italic>muddar</italic> (kept distant) from thee’ may mean, I will not talk to thee; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="N00280">
<head-word>נְהַר</head-word>

<language-reference>same</language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>, 
<italic>to shine</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. O. Gen. XLIV, 3 (Y. נְהִיר). Targ. Job XVIII, 5; a. fr.—Taan. 10
<sup>a</sup> נְהוּר ענני וכ' when the clouds are bright, their waters are little. Pesik. Ekha, p. 123
<sup>a</sup> יִנְהוֹר דינא וכ' let justice shine before thee like this lamp; Yalk. Is. 258 יִנְהַר דיני וכ' let my case shine &c.; Sabb. 116
<sup>b</sup> נְהוֹר נהורך וכ' let thy light (wisdom) shine (prob. to be read: ינהור); a. fr.—
<italic>Part. pass</italic>. נְהִיר; f. נְהִירָא; pl. נְהִירִין; נְהִירָן a) 
<italic>bright, clear</italic>. Lev. R. s. 19 אולפני מה נ' באפי how my learning shines on my face (makes me look well); Yalk. Prov. 964 נרי באפוי (corr. acc.). Y. Sabb. VIII, beg. 11
<sup>a</sup> (נהירן) אפוי נהירין his looks were bright.—Ber. 58
<sup>b</sup> נ' לי שבילי וכ' the paths of the heavens (the courses of the heavenly bodies) are as clear (well-known) to me as the streets &c.; a. fr.—b) 
<italic>knowing clearly, remembering</italic>. Y. Taan. I, 64
<sup>a</sup> bot. נ' את כד הוינן וכ' dost thou remember when we were standing &c.?; Y. Meg. III, 74
<sup>b</sup> bot. Y. Keth. V, 30
<sup>a</sup> top נ' דהויתון וכ' (insert את) dost thou remember that thou &c.? Y. Orl. II, 62
<sup>c</sup> top [read:] נ' את דאמריתון את וכ' dost thou remember that you, thyself and R. J., said &c. Y. Naz. V, end, 54
<sup>b</sup> נ' הוינין וכ' we remember that an old man was here &c.; Y. Ber. VIII, 11
<sup>b</sup> bot. נ' אנן; Gen. R. s. 91 נהרין אנן (corr. acc.); Koh. R. to VII, 11. Ḥull. 54
<sup>a</sup> ולא נְהִירַת ליה וכ' dost thou not remember (recognize) that student &c.? Ib. 93
<sup>a</sup> נְהִירְנָא I remember. B. Bath. 91
<sup>b</sup>; a. fr.—[R. Hash. 34
<sup>b</sup> כי נהירנא לך, v. נְחַר].</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Af.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>אַנְהַר, </binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>, 
<italic>Pa</italic>.</definition>
<notes> נַהֵר </notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to give light, shine; to illumine, brighten, make shine</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. O. Gen. I, 15 (Y. למְנַהֲרָא). Targ. Num. VI, 25; a. fr.—Y. Yoma III, beg. 40
<sup>b</sup> א' מְנַהֲרָא, v. בְּרַק I; Y. R. Hash. II, beg. 57
<sup>d</sup>. Y. Taan. III, 66
<sup>d</sup> bot. שמענן … והיא מְנַהֲרָה we hear that when he entered the Temple court, it used to shine; עאל ואַנְהָרַת he entered, and it shone. Cant. R. to V, 11 הוה מנהרא לי וכ' it (the Law) brightened my countenance by night. Sot. 6
<sup>a</sup> וא' לן עיינין וכ' and he enlightened our eyes (by evidence) from our Mishnah; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to recall to memory, remember</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Peah III, 17
<sup>d</sup> bot. וא' ר' אימי וכ' whereupon R. I. recalled (that he had heard the same tradition), and rescinded his decision. Y. Kidd. I, 61
<sup>a</sup> bot. א' ונפיק וכ' it struck him (that he had forgotten to hear his grandson’s lesson), and he left the bath house &c.; a. e.—Part. pass. מְנַהַר; pl. מְנַהֲרִין. Gen. R. s. 33 אתון … מְנַהֲרִין אנא מְנַהַר ליה you do not remember that poor man, I will remember him.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Ithpe.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>אִתְנְהַר</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be brightened, enlightened</italic>.</definition>

<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to come forth</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Cant. R. to IV, 1 טורא דאִתְנַהַרְתּוּן וכ', v. גָּלַשׁ.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>
